#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# Multi-tenant CLI tool for managing deployment configurations
# Each tenant has isolated namespace and execution context

require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'fileutils'
require 'shellwords'

module TenantIsolation
  TENANT_ROOT = '/var/lib/deployer/tenants'
  ALLOWED_COMMANDS = %w[status restart deploy rollback config].freeze
  
  class SecurityContext
    attr_reader :tenant_id, :role, :permissions
    
    def initialize(tenant_id, role)
      @tenant_id = sanitize_tenant_id(tenant_id)
      @role = role.to_sym
      @permissions = load_permissions
    end
    
    def authorized?(action)
      @permissions.include?(action.to_s)
    end
    
    private
    
    def sanitize_tenant_id(id)
      id.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, '')
    end
    
    def load_permissions
      case @role
      when :admin then ALLOWED_COMMANDS
      when :operator then %w[status restart deploy]
      when :viewer then %w[status config]
      else []
      end
    end
  end

  class CommandDispatcher
    def initialize(context)
      @context = context
      @gadget_chain = []
    end
    
    def dispatch(command, args = {})
      unless @context.authorized?(command)
        raise SecurityError, "Unauthorized: #{command}"
      end
      
      handler = resolve_handler(command)
      handler.call(args)
    end
    
    private
    
    def resolve_handler(command)
      method("handle_#{command}")
    rescue NameError
      raise ArgumentError, "Unknown command: #{command}"
    end
    
    def handle_status(args)
      tenant_dir = tenant_path
      { status: 'running', tenant: @context.tenant_id, path: tenant_dir }
    end
    
    def handle_config(args)
      config_path = File.join(tenant_path, 'config.json')
      return {} unless File.exist?(config_path)
      JSON.parse(File.read(config_path))
    end
    
    def handle_deploy(args)
      validate_deploy_args(args)
      execute_deployment(args)
    end
    
    def handle_restart(args)
      service_name = args[:service] || 'main'
      execute_service_action('restart', service_name)
    end
    
    def handle_rollback(args)
      version = args[:version] || 'previous'
      execute_deployment(args.merge(version: version, rollback: true))
    end
    
    def tenant_path
      File.join(TENANT_ROOT, @context.tenant_id)
    end
    
    def validate_deploy_args(args)
      raise ArgumentError, 'Missing artifact' unless args[:artifact]
      raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid artifact name' unless args[:artifact].match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\z/)
    end
    
    def execute_deployment(args)
      manifest = load_manifest(args)
      chain = build_execution_chain(manifest)
      run_chain(chain, args)
    end
    
    def load_manifest(args)
      manifest_path = File.join(tenant_path, 'manifests', "#{args[:artifact]}.json")
      return default_manifest unless File.exist?(manifest_path)
      JSON.parse(File.read(manifest_path))
    end
    
    def default_manifest
      { 'steps' => ['prepare', 'transfer', 'activate'] }
    end
    
    def build_execution_chain(manifest)
      steps = manifest['steps'] || []
      steps.map { |step| resolve_step(step) }
    end
    
    def resolve_step(step)
      # Steps can reference callable gadgets for extensibility
      if step.is_a?(Hash) && step['type'] == 'shell'
        build_shell_gadget(step)
      elsif step.is_a?(Hash) && step['type'] == 'ruby'
        build_ruby_gadget(step)
      else
        build_internal_step(step.to_s)
      end
    end
    
    def build_shell_gadget(step)
      cmd_template = step['command'].to_s
      # The command template must be a whitelisted program with placeholder
      # arguments. We build an argv array and use the non-shell form of
      # system() so no shell interpretation (metacharacters) can occur.
      allowed_programs = %w[echo cp mv ls cat systemctl]
      lambda do |ctx|
        tokens = Shellwords.split(cmd_template)
        raise SecurityError, 'Empty command' if tokens.empty?
        program = tokens.shift
        unless allowed_programs.include?(program)
          raise SecurityError, "Disallowed program: #{program}"
        end
        argv = tokens.map do |tok|
          interpolated = tok.gsub(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/) do
            key = $1
            value = (ctx[key.to_sym] || ctx[key]).to_s
            unless value.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9._\/-]*\z/)
              raise SecurityError, "Invalid interpolation value for #{key}"
            end
            value
          end
          interpolated
        end
        # Array form of system() bypasses the shell entirely.
        system([program, program], *argv)
      end
    end
    
    def build_ruby_gadget(step)
      # Tenant-provided Ruby expressions for custom logic
      # Only allow safe predefined expressions
      expr = step['expression']
      allowed_expressions = {
        'check_disk_space' => lambda { |ctx| `df -h #{tenant_path}`.lines.last },
        'timestamp' => lambda { |ctx| Time.now.utc.iso8601 },
        'version_check' => lambda { |ctx| RUBY_VERSION }
      }
      key = expr.to_s.strip
      unless allowed_expressions.key?(key)
        raise SecurityError, "Disallowed ruby expression: #{key}"
      end
      allowed_expressions[key]
    end
    
    def build_internal_step(name)
      case name
      when 'prepare'
        lambda { |ctx| FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.join(tenant_path, 'staging')) }
      when 'transfer'
        lambda { |ctx| true } # placeholder
      when 'activate'
        lambda { |ctx| true } # placeholder
      else
        lambda { |ctx| nil }
      end
    end
    
    def run_chain(chain, args)
      results = []
      chain.each do |gadget|
        results << gadget.call(args)
      end
      { success: true, results: results }
    end
    
    def execute_service_action(action, service)
      allowed_actions = %w[restart stop start]
      raise SecurityError, 'Invalid action' unless allowed_actions.include?(action)
      safe_service = service.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, '')
      # Use array form of system() to avoid any shell interpretation.
      system('systemctl', action, "tenant-#{@context.tenant_id}-#{safe_service}")
    end
  end
end

# CLI Entry Point
if __FILE__ == $0
  tenant = ENV['TENANT_ID'] || ARGV[0]
  role = ENV['TENANT_ROLE'] || 'viewer'
  command = ARGV[1] || 'status'
  
  args = {}
  ARGV[2..].each do |arg|
    if arg.include?('=')
      k, v = arg.split('=', 2)
      args[k.to_sym] = v
    end
  end
  
  ctx = TenantIsolation::SecurityContext.new(tenant, role)
  dispatcher = TenantIsolation::CommandDispatcher.new(ctx)
  
  begin
    result = dispatcher.dispatch(command, args)
    puts JSON.pretty_generate(result) if result.is_a?(Hash)
  rescue SecurityError => e
    $stderr.puts "Access denied: #{e.message}"
    exit 1
  rescue => e
    $stderr.puts "Error: #{e.message}"
    exit 2
  end
end
